view.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.title,
    p.price,
    p.active AS catalog_active,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT p.active THEN 'catalog_inactive'::text
            WHEN NOT play_notes_product_eligible(p.*) THEN 'not_billable_notes'::text
            WHEN p.price <= 0::numeric THEN 'unsupported_price'::text
            WHEN t.verified_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND t.active AND s.status = 'ready'::text THEN 'ready'::text
            WHEN s.status = 'ready'::text THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(s.status, 'pending'::text)
        END AS billing_status,
    t.play_sku,
    t.purchase_option_id,
    t.price_inr AS synced_price,
    t.currency_code,
    s.last_synced_at,
    s.last_error,
    s.attempts
   FROM products p
     LEFT JOIN play_price_sync s ON s.price_inr = p.price
     LEFT JOIN play_price_tiers t ON t.play_sku = s.candidate_sku AND t.active AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE am_i_admin();

functions.name: am_i_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.am_i_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.admins where id = auth.uid())
     and (not public.admin_mfa_required() or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', '') = 'aal2')
$function$
